text:
ravi p.: morning team! first day but stuck on provisioning. i can log into redwood.okta.com with email ravi.p@redwood.com but when i try to enroll Okta Verify it never shows a QR and the app says 'No token'. google workspace SSO returns 'Access denied'. didn't receive 1Password invite either. who do i bug?
it-support: welcome, ravi! common paths: (1) your account wasn't assigned apps yet via SCIM, (2) Okta factor needs a reset, or (3) browser popup/cookie issue. try signing in to https://redwood.okta.com in an incognito window and choose "Set up an authenticator app". also check spam for the 1Password invite.
ravi p.: incognito still no QR. error in Okta web: `Enrollment failed: no token available`. looked in spam, nothing.
infra-admin: checking SCIM logs  your user exists but wasn't in group "employee-base" due to a provisioning delay. i've added you to employee-base and resent app assignments + 1Password (SSO) invite. i also forced a factor reset in Okta, which should surface a fresh QR.
julia: fwiw i had the same thing — the QR was blocked by an adblocker popup blocker. try disabling extensions or use an unmodified Chrome profile. also make sure your phone time is set to automatic.
it-support: admin did the reset; you should see a QR now. if not, try the desktop flow from another browser. note: our 1Password invites default to SSO; choose "Sign in with Okta" when the page loads.
ravi p.: ok i opened Edge incognito and new QR appeared. scanned in Okta Verify and got the push. accepted and i'm in. google workspace SSO works now too. 1Password invite arrived and the "Sign in with Okta" button worked  i was able to sign in without creating a master password.
onboarding-bot: Welcome, ravi! :wave: Checklist updated: Okta MFA enrolled, Google Workspace access confirmed, 1Password SSO accepted. Join #new-hires-intro at 3pm. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/internal/onboarding/okta-mfa
ravi p.: thanks all! really appreciate the fast help. one quick security q: do we enable SMS as a fallback MFA or only Okta Verify app?
it-support: we prefer Okta Verify (push/TOTP) as primary. SMS is disabled except for legacy exceptions; if you need an alternate factor for travel, open a ticket and we'll approve per policy. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/internal/security/mfa-policy
ravi p.: noted, thanks :thumbsup:
